target_customer: Contraceptive users; after a COVID-era shift most effort went to a hormone free male contraceptive pill, with partners and eventual licensees paying
problem: Hormonal contraceptives carry side effects, and men have only condoms or vasectomy. YourChoice develops non hormonal options for both.
business_model: Drug development biotech funded by venture rounds and grants; revenue would come from product approval and licensing

founders.name: Akash Bakshi
education: MSc (field and school not stated on company site)
founders.background_notes: Source: company website (yourchoicetx.com). KTVU 2019-04-11 says the company was launched by UC Berkeley researchers.

founders.name: Nadja Mannowetz
education: PhD (school not stated on company site)

competitors.name: Evofem Biosciences (Amphora gel)
competitors.what: Non hormonal vaginal contraceptive gel in late stage development
competitors.traction_then: Public company filing S-1 and 10-K in 2018

competitors.name: Daré Bioscience
competitors.what: San Diego women's health company advancing an investigational non hormonal contraceptive, with a Bayer licensing deal

technical_complexity.rationale: Novel drug discovery for a reversible target (sperm proteins, later RAR-alpha antagonist) requiring preclinical, toxicology and clinical trials.

defensibility.rationale: Patentable molecules and a clinical program that takes years and tens of millions to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired it. Few venture investors backed such companies in 2018 per Xconomy; the company still raised a $15M Series A in 2022.

market_need_then: Condoms and vasectomy were the only male options, and VCs were reluctant to fund contraceptives. Demand for hormone free options was present, shown in press coverage and the company's own YC pitch.

branding.domain_note: Original domain ychoicetx.com redirects to yourchoicetx.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, mission led (women have had the pill for over 60 years)

branding.brand_signature: YCT-529 compound code and the first hormone free male birth control pill story
branding.community_and_virality: Wide press (Fox, KTVU, Fierce Biotech, Nature coverage) about the male pill, mostly about the science rather than the name.

brand_strength.rationale: The male pill news earned wide media reach, and the name states a user empowerment promise; the brand itself is not the story.

pivots.from: Female on demand non hormonal contraceptive first, then male
pivots.to: Most effort on a hormone free male contraceptive pill (YCT-529)
pivots.why: Endpoints reports the COVID pandemic changed the course of the company.

outcome_analysis: YourChoice began as a Berkeley spinout pitched at female contraceptives and shifted after COVID to a male pill. It raised a $15M Series A led by Future Ventures in 2022-07, completed a Phase 1a study by mid 2024, and published in Nature journals in 2025. It is still active and in clinical trials, so the final outcome is open. Long clinical timelines and few investors in the space are the main risks.
notes: Unverified: Seedtable lists seed rounds of $1.6M (2019-01) and $150K (2019-03); KTVU (2019-04-11) says YC provided some funding and the company needed about $2M. A $500K grant in 2024 appears on VCBacked only. Some aggregators report $17.2M total in 7 rounds. MarketScreener names a third founder, Polina Lishko; no source I opened confirms it, so she is not listed. The pivot date 2020 is inferred from Endpoints' COVID wording. Evofem competitor source is the S-1 filed 2018-05 per the search result link.
